question: Which of the following is NOT an example of Mass Communication?
solution:
The correct answer is a __**door-to-door campaign.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Mass communication is a process in which a **person, group of people or an association sends a communication through a channel of communication to a large group of anonymous and miscellaneous people and associations.**
 
• You can suppose a large group of anonymous and miscellaneous people as either the general public or a member of the general public.
 
• **Channels of communication include broadcast TV, radio, social media, films, and print.**
 
• The sender of the communication is generally a professional prophet that frequently represents an association.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• There are 5 types of Mass Communication:
 
 
• **Print Media:**

 
 
• **​**Publish media is a common term that can source colorful forms of published communication.
 
• When you're looking to communicate with followership, it’s important to understand ‘ what is print media ’ and what your options are to partake in information.
 
• publish media is a form of journalism that involves your information being published and circulated.
 
 
 
• **Broadcast Media:**
 
 
• Broadcast media is defined as different media channels or broadcasters similar to the TV, internet, audio podcasts, videotape content, and others.
 
• The primary purpose of broadcasting media is to broadcast and communicate with the public.**​**
 
 
 
• **Outdoor Media:**
 
 
• **​**Out-of-door media is any kind of advertising that directly reaches consumers specifically when they aren't at home.
 
• Made to snare peoples ’ attention when out and about. This form of media also goes by OOH( Out- of- Home) advertising.
 
 
 
• **Transit Media:**
 
 
• It refers to advertising placed in, on, or around modes of public transportation motorcars, galleries, and hacks, as well as machine, train, and shelter stations.
 
• Conveyance media can be a great way to reach a really different followership.**​**
 
 
 
• **Digital Media:**
 
 
• **​**Any communication medium using one or further decoded machine-readable data formats is called digital media.
 
• On a digital electronics device, digital media may be generated, viewed, distributed, edited, heeded to, and archived.
